=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:748-776 (heal_impl_repro_check, repro-tree transfer block) | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The repro tree is a clean detached HEAD worktree (`git worktree add --detach "${root}/repro-tree" HEAD`), but the `review_untrusted_workspace.py transfer` baseline check needs every snapshot-baseline name to be in the target. The baseline includes untracked, non-ignored host files (scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:373 `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard`; `.txt` passes `allowed()` via SUFFIXES line 33). Those files are missing from the repro tree, so the transfer fails `host_baseline_changed` (review_untrusted_workspace.py:466-469). `cmd_scope` then reports `in_scope`, and every `[repro-required]` heal is held with exit 43 / `repro_tree_unavailable` → `refuse repro_not_fixed` → `ai:needs-human` before it can reach `fixed`.
  WHY: The pipeline writes `./pre_assembled_static.txt` into the checkout root before the heal step (.github/workflows/implement.yml:2722) and removes it only afterwards, so the success path is unreachable whenever that file is untracked and unignored. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated this BLOCKER (all real runs), and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it MAJOR. glm says `.gitignore:11` covers the file in this repo, so the failure applies to consumer repos and to any checkout with untracked non-ignored files. minimax_minimax-m3 disputed the finding: it says `.gitignore:11` excludes the file, and that the fragile case is documented and handled fail-closed by `test_repro_tree_transfer_failure_logs_its_reason_token`. sonnet also notes that the gate tree has the same pattern (lines 299-313): it fails open as `gate_tree_unavailable` before the new `--venv` prepare block runs. Both reviewers propose the same fix: copy baseline-only host files into the repro tree with `cp --no-dereference --preserve=mode` (glm adds a fingerprint check) and add a fixture whose expected outcome is `fixed`.
- scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:620, 636-638, 769-775 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The scope classifier returns `unknown` when `enumerate_workspace(..., strict=True)` raises, rather than classifying the rejected edit as out of scope.
  WHY: If the repro-tree transfer fails its baseline check and the edited snapshot also contains a rejected path (for example a new `.github/ai/*` file), the catch-all returns `unknown`, so the caller exits 43 / `repro_not_fixed` instead of keeping the `out_of_heal_scope` refusal (exit 42). The source rated it NIT.

  PROBLEM: In a real implement run the repro-tree transfer always fails with host_baseline_changed, so every `[repro-required]` heal is held with exit 43 / repro_tree_unavailable and none can reach `fixed`. The snapshot baseline includes untracked host files (`snapshot()` in scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py, around line 373). `.github/workflows/implement.yml` line 2722 writes `./pre_assembled_static.txt`, and scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh lines 74-78 delete it only after the editor runs. `.txt` is in SUFFIXES (line 33), and the reviewer claims the repo has no root `.gitignore`. `transfer()` lines 466-469 raise "host baseline changed", and implement.yml lines 3687-3689 then run `refuse repro_not_fixed`. The gate tree has the same pattern (lines 299-313), so it fails open as `gate_tree_unavailable` and returns before the new `--venv` prepare block runs. The new test `test_repro_tree_transfer_failure_logs_its_reason_token` treats this path as expected behaviour.
  WHY: Once WORKFLOW_HEAL_REPRODUCE_ENABLED=true, every `[repro-required]` heal is refused and handed to a person, so the fail-then-pass acceptance criterion holds only in the test fixture. Minimal fix: copy missing regular, non-symlink manifest files into the repro tree with `cp --no-dereference --preserve=mode` (about 6 lines) and add a fixture whose expected outcome is `fixed`.   PROBLEM: The clean detached HEAD repro tree is missing untracked, non-ignored baseline files (review_untrusted_workspace.py:373; SUFFIXES line 33/154), so the transfer raises "host baseline changed" (scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:466-469). .github/workflows/implement.yml:2722 writes `pre_assembled_static.txt` before the heal block at 3684-3693, and cleanup (`add_virtual_cleanup_path` at implement.yml:4342) runs only after.
